'''Richard Ehrenborg''' is a Swedish mathematician working in [[algebraic combinatorics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/richard-ehrenborg|title=Richard Ehrenborg profile page at IAS|access-date=September 27, 2019}}</ref>  He is known for developing the [[quasisymmetric function]] of a poset.<ref>{{cite journal | last=Ehrenborg | first=Richard | title=On posets and Hopf algebras | journal=[[Advances in Mathematics]] | volume=119 | issue=1 | year=1996 | issn=0001-8708 | doi=10.1006/aima.1996.0026 | pages=1–25 | mr=1383883| doi-access=free }}</ref> He currently holds the Ralph E. and Norma L. Edwards Research Professorship at the University of Kentucky <ref name="uky.edu">{{cite web|url=https://math.as.uky.edu/mathematics-names-new-royster-edwards-chairs-0|title=Mathematics Names New Royster, Edwards Chairs - Mathematics|website=University of Kentucky Mathematics Department|last=Allen|first=Jennifer T.|access-date=September 27, 2019}}</ref> and is the first recipient of the Royster Research Professor at
[[University of Kentucky]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.as.uky.edu/sites/default/files/a2.pdf|title=Faculty News|website=University of Kentucky Mathematics Department newsletter|date=Fall 2006|access-date=September 27, 2019}}</ref>

Ehrenborg earned his Ph.D. from [[MIT]] in 1993<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=18012}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Gian-Carlo Rota]].
He is a descendant of another  {{ill|lt=Richard Ehrenborg|Richard Ehrenborg (jurist)|sv|Richard Ehrenborg}},<ref name="uky.edu"/> (born 1655) who was a professor and Rektor of [[Lund University]]. He is also a juggler and magician.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.marshall.edu/wamnewsletter/2016/10/department-of-mathematics-to-present-distinguished-reasearcher-richard-ehrenborg/|title=Department of Mathematics to present distinguished researcher Richard Ehrenborg|website=Marshall University newsletter|access-date=September 27, 2019}}</ref>
